description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Keaton Mitchell was limited in practice on Friday.

items.title: Keaton Mitchell (hip) limited in practice Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Mike Evans has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Evans will remain sidelined as expected. He remains week-to-week.
items.title: Mike Evans (Achilles) ruled out Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Jaylen Wright (quad) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Indianapolis Colts.
items.impact: Wright is going to be good to go for Sunday's game. He was able to practice in full all week, so his quad issue is nothing serious at this point. He isn't expected to be fantasy relevant moving forward, however.
items.title: Jaylen Wright (quad) good to go for Week 10

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Zaire Franklin (shin) is doubtful to play in Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings.
items.impact: Franklin has been out for multiple weeks due to a shin issue, and it looks like he's going to be sidelined for yet another game on Sunday, as he's currently considered doubtful to play. The team has their bye week coming up in Week 11, however, so it seems likely that he will be good to go after that.
items.title: Zaire Franklin (shin) doubtful to play Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Chris Brooks (ankle) is listed questionable for Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings.
items.impact: Brooks has been out for multiple weeks while recovering from an ankle issue, but his return to the lineup may come on Sunday, as he is officially considered questionable to play against the Vikings. If he's active, he may actually see a solid amount of opportunities with Josh Jacobs (finger) set to be sidelined for this game.
items.title: Chris Brooks (ankle) listed questionable for Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Micah Parsons (knee) won't play in Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings.
items.impact: Parsons isn't quite ready to make his return to the lineup and will be sidelined for another game on Sunday. He will likely be ready to go after the team's bye in Week 11, so their defensive front will have to continue to make due without him in the meantime.
items.title: Micah Parsons (knee) won't play Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Skyy Moore (ankle) is considered questionable for Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings.
items.impact: Moore has been sidelined by an ankle injury for close to a month, but he is questionable and will have a chance to make his return to the lineup on Sunday. His availability won't have a big impact for fantasy purposes either way, however.
items.title: Skyy Moore (ankle) considered questionable for Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Josh Whyle (concussion) will be unavailable for Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings.
items.impact: Whyle is still going through the NFL's concussion protocols and will be unavailable to play on Sunday as a result. His absence isn't expected to have a big impact from a fantasy perspective, however.
items.title: Josh Whyle (concussion) unavailable for Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Javon Bullard (ankle/knee) is listed questionable for Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings.
items.impact: Bullard may be ruled out for Sunday's game, as he is currently considered questionable to play due to two injuries he's nursing. His absence would make life easier for Kirk Cousins and Co. on the other side of the ball.
items.title: Javon Bullard (ankle/knee) listed questionable for Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Sean Rhyan (ankle) will be sidelined for Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings.
items.impact: The Packers are set to be without their starting center in Week 10. Rhyan has been ruled out with an ankle issue, and it's unclear if it will cause him to miss more time beyond this game or not. Green Bay's offensive front will be weaker than usual while he's out.
items.title: Sean Rhyan (ankle) sidelined for Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Lukas Van Ness (back) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings.
items.impact: Van Ness was able to make his return to practice on Friday but is still considered questionable to play heading into the weekend. His status will likely depend on how his back feels closer to game time on Sunday.
items.title: Lukas Van Ness (back) questionable for Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Josh Jacobs (finger) has officially been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings.
items.impact: As expected, Jacobs has officially been ruled out after undergoing a procedure to address a finger injury he suffered last week. There's a real chance that he will miss more time beyond this game, so fantasy managers should expect more work for Kaleb Johnson and MarShawn Lloyd for the foreseeable future.
items.title: Josh Jacobs (finger) officially ruled out for Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Xavier McKinney (foot) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings.
items.impact: McKinney is uncertain to play on Sunday, as he is currently considered questionable to play due to a groin issue. He is one of Green Bay's best defensive players, so their secondary will be considerably worse if he's sidelined this week.
items.title: Xavier McKinney (foot) questionable to play Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Andrew Wingard (groin) is considered questionable for Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Rams.
items.impact: Wingard may not be available to play on Sunday, as he's currently dealing with a groin issue of some kind that left him sidelined for Thursday and Friday's practices. Arizona's secondary will be weaker than usual if he's ruled out.
items.title: Andrew Wingard (groin) considered questionable for Sunday
